name: Lowell Reynolds
bio: Lowell Andre Reynolds is a Nashville-based music producer and audio engineer with more than 20 years in the music industry, including Grammy-recognized engineering work. He holds degrees from Indiana University Bloomington and Indiana University East and is a law student at Syracuse University College of Law. Born in Florida and raised in Indiana, he is running as an independent for Tennessee's 7th Congressional District.

platform.point: Wants to restore checks and balances and limit executive overreach.
Presents himself as unaffiliated with either party, putting the Constitution and individual liberty first.
Aims to shift power from Washington back to citizens and hold leaders accountable.
Describes himself as a centrist who favors balance and pragmatism, pairing progress with respect for national history and values.
Pledges to judge each bill on its merits and its benefit to Tennessee rather than by party line.
